The name Kamles is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and symbolizes beauty, grace, and divine protection. Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kamala’ meaning ‘lotus’ and ‘Goddess Kamal’, this name holds significant value in Hindu culture and mythology.

Kamles is a popular name among Hindus and is often given to children as a symbol of their divine connection to the goddess Kamal. The name is also believed to bring good fortune and blessings to the child and their family.
